title: Manchester orb sized at 24 inches at most
summary: Mick West tells of Manchester orb sized at 24 inches at most, about June 2024 at Manchester Airport, UK, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We did very detailed analysis 3D recreation of this thing from this exact viewpoints and using the the data there at the most 24 in.

plain: Mick West, a researcher known for skeptical looks at UFO videos, talks about a round glowing object, an "orb", filmed near Manchester Airport in England in June 2024. He says his team rebuilt the scene in 3D from the exact viewpoints and found the object was at most 24 inches across. He offers this to show the object was small, not a large craft.
